//: Durable preferences, MERGED into ~/.claude/settings.json every time install.sh runs.
Only put a key here if it should be true on every machine you work on. The merge is
key-by-key and additive: anything already in ~/.claude/settings.json that isn't named
here is left completely alone, so this file cannot clobber machine-specific settings.
DELIBERATELY NOT HERE — set these per machine, via /model and /config:
model            Claude Code rewrites it at runtime (a /model switch strips it), so
tracking it produced spurious deletions in the repo. It also encodes a
model id ('opus[1m]') that ages out as new models ship.
modelSettings    Keyed by model id (e.g. 'claude-opus-5'), so it goes stale the same way.
The intent worth carrying is 'newest Opus, xhigh effort', not the string.
permissions.defaultMode  'auto' = act without prompting for routine tool calls.
effortLevel              Reasoning effort. 'xhigh' trades latency for depth.
tui                      'fullscreen' takes over the terminal instead of scrolling inline.
skipAutoPermissionPrompt Suppresses the automatic permission prompt on startup.
enabledPlugins           Plugins to turn on. Only public-marketplace ones belong here;
install them first (see README), an unknown one is a no-op.
preferredNotifChannel    How Claude signals it needs you. 'terminal_bell' rings the
terminal's bell, which works in any terminal.
